blocks.orig: The White Sands Resort is one of the larger luxury hotels on the north coast of Dar Es Salaam, 25 kilometres from the city centre. Situated on an idyllic private beach, the resort offers 146 seaside rooms of different sizes, but all air-conditioned, equipped with free WiFI and amenities to make your stay comfortable, such as modern ensuite bathrooms, large beds with mosquito nets, tea- and coffee-making stations, TV and a balcony or terrace to enjoy the view from. Besides the hotel boasts a restaurant with an ocean view, and two bars that serve light meals; one near the swimming pool and one on a jetty in the ocean. Beach lovers won’t be disappointed with direct access to the beach, watersports and the possibility to go to the nearby uninhabited island of Mbudya for the day. Families with kids can even opt to go to the nearby Water World park, as the entrance is free for guests at White Sands!
blocks.html: On the north coast of Dar Es Salaam, 25 kilometres from the city centre, the White Sands Resort is one of the bigger luxury hotels. Set on an idyllic private beach, it has 146 rooms by the sea in various sizes. Every room has air conditioning, free WiFI and amenities for a comfortable stay, such as a modern ensuite bathroom, large beds with mosquito nets, tea and coffee facilities, a TV and a balcony or terrace from which to enjoy the view. The hotel also has a restaurant overlooking the ocean and two bars serving light meals: one by the swimming pool and one on a jetty out in the ocean. If you love the beach, you will appreciate the direct beach access, the watersports and the option of a day trip to the nearby uninhabited island of Mbudya. Families with children can even visit the Water World park close by, since guests at White Sands get in for free!
